attachments.insertion_landmark: proximal phalanx of the great toe (medial and lateral sesamoids)

actions: flexes the great toe's MTP joint

functional_compartments.name: Medial head

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Inserts via the medial sesamoid bone, one of the two sesamoids embedded in this muscle's tendons beneath the 1st metatarsal head -- a classic radiographic landmark and a site of sesamoiditis.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_from: middle-lowest point of the sole of the foot
motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_to: middle-lowest point of the great toe
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Reported for the muscle as a whole; the medial and lateral heads are not separately mapped in the source.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity, Part IV -- Distal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(10):508 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17100508 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Lee, Yi and others)

functional_compartments.name: Lateral head

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Inserts via the lateral sesamoid; often partly blended with adductor hallucis's transverse head fibers at their shared insertion.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_from: middle-lowest point of the sole of the foot
motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_to: middle-lowest point of the great toe
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Reported for the muscle as a whole; the medial and lateral heads are not separately mapped in the source.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity, Part IV -- Distal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(10):508 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17100508 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Lee, Yi and others)
